rule_text: Applicants with full-time corporate, engineering, or medical salaried roles demonstrate Tier 1 stability. Approve standard DTI limits without additional cash-flow verifications.
For gig economy workers (e.g., Uber, Doordash) or freelancers, verify cash flow stability. Free monthly cash flow must cover at least 100% of proposed monthly loan installments.
Maximum Debt-to-Income (DTI) allowed for unsecured personal loans is 60%. Any application where calculated DTI exceeds 0.60 must result in an automatic decline.
Alternative risk scores below 550 indicate high default probability. Flag for manual review or decline unless applicant possesses substantial liquid reserves.
